name: GlobeStar Therapeutics Corporation
summary: GlobeStar Therapeutics Corporation is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firm dedicated to advancing proprietary drug formulations. These innovative treatments specifically target multiple sclerosis (MS) and various other neurodegenerative disorders. Established in 2016, the company was formerly known as AngioSoma, Inc., rebranding to GlobeStar Therapeutics Corporation in July 2021. Its operations are headquartered in Richland, Washington.
